title: Things To Do in Boone NC This Fall Weekend
excerpt: October in Boone is one of the most spectacular times of year — the leaves are turning, the festivals are running, and the mountains are calling. If you've ever thought about owning a piece of the High Country, a fall weekend visit might be exactly the nudge you need.
